name: Panama
about: Dry season (mid-Dec–Apr) is best for the Pacific side; Bocas stays wetter and greener year-round.
overview: A canal that reshaped world trade, rainforest just outside the capital, and the laid-back Caribbean surf towns of Bocas del Toro.
costOverview: Everyday food, coffee, and taxis are affordable — a canal transit tour is a genuine splurge most visitors consider once.

specialSeasons.text: Wettest months on the Pacific side — Canal transits and Panama City still work fine, but outdoor plans need flexibility.
Best conditions for both the Pacific side and the San Blas islands; Bocas del Toro's Caribbean side stays warm and green nearly year-round.
